_doc: Quick Match (DECISIONS D-017; research/round_flow.md §2, §3, §7, §8, §10, §14): 4 rounds, first to 3, the sides swap after round 2, one sudden-death overtime round at 2–2; no bans; a random site the defenders know, revealed to attackers as the round starts; operator pick 20 s, 15 s when the sides didn't swap [Y8S3]; prep 45 s and action 180 s [Y10S2]; plant and disable 7 s [Y6S1]; the 10 s Attacker Safeguard and red walls up for the first 10 s of action [Y8S3]; pre-setups. Team damage is on in action, off in prep [Y7S4] (core_mechanics.md §11). The round count is Fandom's [Y6S1]; whether the safeguard is still in the game, the fuse in Quick Match, the overtime round's sides and when exactly the site is revealed are unverified, and the round-end banner (6 s, no replay) is ours. Reinforcements: Siege's pool of 10 scaled for small teams (D-015), plus the pre-setups (DESIGN §9). The host may switch the scaling off.
